Weekly discussion: style! Feel free to post anything here (or as its own post) related to style or design in creating maps.
Do y'all have any preferences on map projection? I'm fond of Robinson myself. Similar to what we're all used to but less distortion.

Ah, I'm a fan of Robinson as well, but my personal favourite is the Waterman Butterfly, which imho is the best way to deal with distortion.

I switch between the two (for the Waterman, I do it as close as is possible to the continents' shapes but often it's not much of a butterfly or I have to cut a continent) in my own maps, but the Waterman is much more of a challenge to use.

I can't bring myself to use a cut map, because I just don't find them aesthetically pleasing or intuitive to read, though the lack of distortion is tempting. I might make a small test one just to see what I think about it.

Greetings, fellow Survivor viewers.

I know this Survivor community is a little small at the moment, but I'm hoping for it to pick-up more people in time for Season 31 -- which I think that most people are generally excited about. I follow the off-season content casually, but once a season is in the midst of airing, my enthusiasm generally skyrockets. So, in the meantime, for the people that are already here, and the people who make their way to this subverse in the coming months, I would just like to start an ice breaker -- or a "Survivor mixer" (if you will) -- so that we have sort of some reference points when discussing topics for users.

Let us limit it to: 1) When did you start watching?; 2) How many seasons have you seen (and which ones haven't you seen)?; 3) What is your favorite season?; 4) Who is your favorite player?; 5) Who do you think is the best player?; 6) Which Survivor communities are you a part of?; 7) And, just for funzies, what would be your luxury item if you ever decided to play?.

Introductions: Hello to Superfans and Casual Viewers

1) Been watching since the very beginning. Reprezent!

2) I have seen all of them multiple times, and have every single episode recorded (including preview specials, mid-season recaps, and the early "back from" specials. Fuck the CBS "All Access."

3) Pearl Islands is my favorite season. I know the famous "Outcasts" twist diminishes it for a lot of people, but in mind, it is forgivable because it was in-line with the pirate theme of the season.

4) I know I will get a little flack for this, but I have to go with "Boston Rob" Mariano as my favorite. He has brought a lot of entertainment to the show, and he was kind enough to send me a personalized "get well" video when I was hospitalized with a life-threatening illness. 5) Sandra is the best player. She's won twice.

6) I am a member of Rob Cesternino's RHAP (Rob Has a Podcast) community, and Mario Lanza's POS (Previously on Survivor) Facebook group.
